MAI Animal Health is a veterinarian’s source for solutions in the animal healthcare industry. As a diverse family of trusted brands under one common ownership, veterinarians can streamline their buying experience for veterinary instruments and supplies.

With more than 40 years of veterinary experience and manufacturing expertise, MAI Animal Health is committed to improving both the quality and efficiency of animal healthcare solutions.

Explore our family of brands and learn more about our products and services with product overviews, veterinary wet labs and educational videos. Subscribe to our channel for exciting announcements of new, innovative and practical solutions to enhance the lives of animals and their caregivers.
